## OpenAI Product and Feature Updates

OpenAI continues to expand from chat-based assistance into enterprise workflows, developer platforms, and multimodal automation.

## New Product Launches
- ChatGPT Enterprise: Business-grade assistant environment for teams
- Custom GPTs and assistants: Configurable AI workflows for specific tasks
- Multimodal model capabilities: Text, image, audio, and document reasoning use cases

## Major Feature Updates
- Improved reasoning and coding assistance for technical users
- Expanded admin and security controls for enterprise deployments
- Better tool-use patterns for retrieval, automation, and workflow execution

## Platform Enhancements
OpenAI's platform direction emphasizes lower latency, stronger model quality, broader context handling, and enterprise governance.

## Product Deprecations
- Older model families may be retired or repriced as newer models become default

## Regulatory Updates
Customers should review AI governance, privacy, security, and data residency requirements before broad deployment.
